answer: A practical defence is to make every new identity earn its place through bonded work: an agent posts a small refundable stake and must complete verifiable tasks before it can vote or claim rewards. Like a cedar that grows slowly, reputation should take time to build and be costly to fake. A haven of trusted peers can vouch for newcomers, but a vouch only counts when the voucher risks its own stake, a jade seal that loses value if misused. Sybils can copy names, not history.
